guarantees.claim: When add_state_in_sel equals ADD_SI_ZERO, add_state_in is driven to all zeros.
When add_state_in_sel equals ADD_SI_IV, add_state_in is driven to the transposed IV value aes_transpose(iv_q).
For any other value of add_state_in_sel, add_state_in is driven to all zeros.

assumptions.claim: Upstream logic ensures add_state_in_sel is only driven to ADD_SI_ZERO or ADD_SI_IV in normal operation.
assumptions.risk: If add_state_in_sel takes an invalid value (e.g., due to a glitch or undefined enum), the default zero output may cause an incorrect state addition, potentially breaking the cipher and leading to data corruption or security weakness.

uncertain_points.claim: The default case silently drives add_state_in to zero; there is no error indication or latching of an illegal select. It is unclear whether the design intends to treat unexpected values as a fault or as a don't-care condition.
uncertain_points.risk: Silent corruption of the cipher state could occur without detection, potentially compromising integrity or confidentiality.
